description:
Replace the current iodata-emitting pipeline with one that emits a %Phoenix.LiveView.Rendered{} struct whose dynamic fn is trivial. This eliminates the assigns requirement and the use_memo-inside-closure crash pattern. READ FIRST: - lib/filament/vnode_compiler.ex (full file — this is the primary change target) - lib/filament/tag_engine.ex (the forked engine from T1 — its compile/2 output is the input here) - deps/phoenix_live_view/lib/phoenix_live_view/engine.ex lines 100-153 (Rendered struct definition) - deps/phoenix_live_view/lib/phoenix_live_view/diff.ex (how dynamic fn is called) BACKGROUND: Phoenix.LiveView.TagEngine.compile/2 returns quoted Elixir AST. That AST, when evaluated at runtime, produces a %Phoenix.LiveView.Rendered{} struct. The dynamic fn inside takes a `changed?` boolean and may reference `assigns` from outer scope. The problem: Phoenix's diff engine re-evaluates the dynamic fn outside the Filament render context. Any hook call (use_memo, use_state, use_observable) or child component render inside the fn crashes because there is no active fiber context. THE FIX — hoist all expressions out of the dynamic fn: Before (current): %Rendered{ static: ["
", "
"], dynamic: fn _ -> [live_to_iodata(count)] end, # runs outside context — crashes fingerprint: 123 } After (target): _d0 = live_to_iodata(count) # runs NOW, in render pass, context active %Rendered{ static: ["
", "
"], dynamic: fn _ -> [_d0] end, # trivial: just returns a local fingerprint: 12345678, caller: {__MODULE__, {:render, 1}, "file.ex", 10} } STEPS: 1. In VNodeCompiler.compile/2, after getting `quoted` from Filament.TagEngine.compile/2, pass it through a new function: `hoist_dynamics(quoted)` which returns `{preamble_ast, rendered_ast}` where preamble_ast is a list of `_dN = expr` assignments and rendered_ast is the %Rendered{} literal with slot exprs replaced by `_dN` refs. 2. Implement hoist_dynamics/1: - Walk the quoted AST looking for the %Rendered{} struct literal: `{:%{}, _meta, fields}` where one field has key `:dynamic` - Extract the dynamic fn body: the fn is `{:fn, _, [{:->, _, [[], body]}]}` or similar — find the list that is the return value - For each element `expr` in that list at index N: a. Generate assignment: `{:=, [], [{:_dN, [], nil}, expr]}` b. Replace expr in the list with `{:_dN, [], nil}` - Reassemble the %Rendered{} with the replaced dynamic fn 3. Apply wrap_in_use_memo to EACH HOISTED BINDING (the `expr` side of `_dN = expr`), not inside the dynamic fn. The use_memo call runs in the render context — safe. Dep computation logic in VNodeCompiler is unchanged. 4. Add fingerprint computation. After extracting the static list from the %Rendered{}: ```elixir static_list = # extracted from the struct AST <> = :erlang.md5(:erlang.term_to_binary([source | static_list])) ``` where `source` is the template source string (available in compile/2). Emit the computed integer as the fingerprint field. (Phoenix uses the block AST; using the source string is equivalent and simpler.) 5. Populate the caller field. In compile/2, `caller` is a %Macro.Env{}. Emit: `{caller.module, caller.function, caller.file, caller.line}` as the caller: field in %Rendered{}. 6. Do NOT call live_to_iodata on %Rendered{} values. When a dynamic slot holds a child component result (already a %Rendered{}), hoist it unwrapped: `_dN = child_component_result` NOT `_dN = live_to_iodata(child_component_result)`. The diff engine pattern-matches on the struct type. Collapsing to iodata loses the nested diff tree. Detect this case by checking if the slot expr is already a %Rendered{} call (look for the struct tag in the AST) — if unsure, do not wrap. 7. The final output of compile/2 should be a `quote do … end` block that looks like: ```elixir ( _d0 = _d1 = %Phoenix.LiveView.Rendered{ static: ["", "", ""], dynamic: fn _ -> [_d0, _d1] end, fingerprint: , caller: {Mod, {:render, 1}, "file.ex", 10} } ) ``` 8. Delete transform_at_assigns/2 and its call. It transformed `assigns.foo` → bare var. With no @foo in templates and no assigns in generated code, this is dead. The sanitized_caller workaround was already removed in T1. ACCEPTANCE: - `mix test` passes - Chrome: localhost:4000 — add todos, toggle, filter; all work as before - Verify `assigns = {}` is no longer needed: add a test component that uses ~F without any assigns binding in scope and confirm it compiles and renders correctly - The assigns = {} line in examples/todo/lib/todo_web/components/todo_list.ex can be removed; the server should still work after restarting
title: Rewrite VNodeCompiler codegen: emit hoisted %Rendered{} with trivial dynamic fn
